title: field_ops.custody.delivered v1
description: Emitted when a custody event closes the delivery of a lab-delivery order (the kind configured as the tenant's lab delivery kind). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :custody, :delivered] telemetry event from Custody.maybe_emit_delivered. The module that originated the order (for example Agenda, for a home sample collection) consumes it to close its own record. Fields live under `data` (build_envelope/3).

event_id.description: custody_events row that closed the delivery.

field_order_id.description: field_orders row whose custody was delivered (UUID).

appointment_id.description: The agenda appointment the order came from (agenda-ex creates a pickup_sample order from a lab_domicile appointment); null for any other order. Agenda closes its appointment once the sample is delivered (ADR-37 §18.3 «Cierre con el módulo de origen»). Added 2026-10-21, field-ops 0.0.128, additive.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

delivered_at.description: Timestamp of the custody event that closed the delivery (ISO 8601).

attachments.description: Evidence attached to the delivery (download URLs or descriptors).

external_ref.description: Upstream reference of the order (for example the appointment or exam id).

share_token.description: Public tracking token (a credential: do not log).

metadata.description: The order's free metadata map (appointment_id lives here for orders created from Agenda).
